name: the bank under the whole constitution -- sentence-level cases for Haro v0.24 (ZC3)
comment: Written BEFORE the court code (the W discipline). Each case runs the court forged from bank_v24.haro on rnxc AND on the oracle; the two must print the same bytes. 'first' is a fragment of the first output line; 'contains' fragments of the whole output; 'record' the C2 record on the second line of a refine refusal; 'diagnose' the first diagnostic of a diagnose run; a 'sequence' runs its steps on one copy of the sentence and joins their outputs. The proposals are ledger/ceiling_llm.rfn and ledger/ceiling_external.rfn, unchanged from v0.23 (the bank's main account has the same ceiling).

cases.name: the clean bank is a sentence: two accounts, one limit, two flows, two vaults
the meta-court reads the bank's declaration under all six articles, with its zone
Art. 5 through the required seat: a vault held by nobody is refused, the article named
contains: HELD_BY is required on VAULT orphan_vault

cases.name: Art. 5 through the envelope: the same refusal diagnosed carries the kind's code NO_HOLDER and cites article:5
Art. 5 through the reference: a vault entered through a flow nothing declares is refused in the kind's own words, the article named
contains: VAULT ghost_vault is entered through 'nowhere', and no FLOW of that name is declared

cases.name: Art. 5 through the envelope: the dangling entry diagnosed carries NO_FLOW and cites article:5
Art. 3 through the voice: the vaults are told, holder and entry alike
contains: bank_vault is held by the_bank, entered through nightly_posting.
clearing_vault is held by the_clearing_house, entered through settlement.

cases.name: Art. 3 through the audit chain: an admitted and a refused proposal are two events, kept beside the sentence and answered as a query
the audit chain before any event: the query says so, by name
the chain is article 3's: the v0.23 ledger, under no visible_state, keeps none and says so
contains: no audit chain: ledger is under no visible_state
